_comment: Central affiliate merchant configuration. Product pages NEVER hardcode affiliate links — every CTA resolves through data/products.json -> merchant key -> this file. To go live: replace url_template placeholders with your real affiliate-tagged URLs and set enabled=true.

aliexpress._comment: Tracking ID 'default'. Tracked links are per-product short links (https://s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_<code>) generated via the portal Link Generator (Tools > Link Generator) or tools/aliexpress_import.py via the Open Platform API. There is no URL-template affiliate tag for AliExpress.
aliexpress.disclosure_short: QA Affiliate may earn a commission on qualifying AliExpress purchases.
aliexpress.name: AliExpress

amazon._comment: Set enabled=true and paste your SiteStripe / Associates tagged URL template. {product_url} is replaced per product.
amazon.disclosure_short: As an Amazon Associate, QA Affiliate may earn from qualifying purchases.
amazon.name: Amazon

temu.disclosure_short: QA Affiliate may earn a commission on qualifying Temu purchases.
temu.name: Temu

wiring_instructions: 1. Join each affiliate program (Amazon Associates, AliExpress Portals, Temu Affiliate).
2. For each product in data/products.json, replace the example.com affiliate_url with your real tagged product URL.
3. Set the merchant enabled=true in this file once its links are real.
4. Keep affiliate IDs and API keys OUT of frontend files — server-side or tag-manager only.
5. Never invent prices, ratings, discounts or review counts. Use merchant feed/API data or verified manual entry.
